candidates.title: Sort frequent customer questions for review

demandEvidence.chore: Handle frequent customer questions arriving through WhatsApp and email.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: We get 50–100 customer queries a day on WhatsApp and email, and want an AI agent to handle most of them.

ease.reason: A mock inbox could classify supplied sample questions, but the request provides no implementation reference or setup evidence.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small service firms handling frequent WhatsApp and email questions might pay; the request does not establish payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week synthetic test could sort sample questions and draft replies; live messaging access and language quality remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed classifier and draft step could repeat, but a person must approve replies and handle uncertain cases; no implementation is documented.

evidence.reason: The post states 50–100 daily customer queries across WhatsApp and email and asks for an agent, but provides no corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed as a narrow sample-inbox classification and reply-drafting experiment, then rejected: it duplicates the support inbox workflow and customer in recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6.

rejected.title: Tell HN: Don't use Fathom Analytics (founder is blocking criticism)
rejected.reason: No bounded manual task is stated: the excerpt questions whether a product serves its customers and says to use another analytics product. It does not describe an automatable chore.

rejected.title: Show HN: Robin – Non-algorithmic Twitter client
rejected.reason: The excerpt only says “Information pollution affects all of us.” It identifies no concrete task or repeatable workflow to assess.

rejected.title: Self-hosted n8n on Railway, locked out of owner account after upgrade, reset email fails (no SMTP)
rejected.reason: This is a one-off account recovery/access problem. It is not a recurring professional-services chore, and automating account recovery risks changing access or losing workflows.

rejected.title: Google Sheets connection stuck on "Creating a connection..."
rejected.reason: This is a one-off connection failure report; the stated reminder automation is a desired future scenario, not an established repeated manual chore. Prior assessments of this exact notice also found no implementation evidence.

rejected.title: Weekly keyword search volume to Google Sheets (Apify)
rejected.reason: The only excerpt says the schedule is Monday 9 am UTC and configurable; it does not state a concrete task or problem.

rejected.title: Show HN: MXValidation – Send an email and get an authentication and DNS report
rejected.reason: The excerpt is a product title describing an existing email-to-DNS-report tool, not evidence of a manual task or request for an AI service.

rejected.title: Built an n8n Lead Capture Workflow with Apollo, AI Scoring & Failure Handling
rejected.reason: The post says its author already built a lead-capture and qualification workflow. It states no unresolved chore or service request; proposing another lead qualification workflow would invent demand.

rejected.title: N8n Expert Needed: AI WhatsApp Support Agent (Hindi + English)
rejected.reason: The concrete inbox task is assessable, but it duplicates the support-inbox workflow and online customer-support buyer in recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6.

steps.message: Assessed all eight assigned discussion identities. One concrete repeated support chore was scored, but it overlaps the recent support-inbox workflow and customer; the other excerpts do not establish an eligible distinct repeatable chore. No post proposed.
